description: Header file declaring APIs and function prototypes for WAN manager DML operations related to WAN management, including parameter get/set, validate, commit, and rollback functions, as well as group management functions when unification is enabled.

methods.name: WanManager_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves a ULONG parameter value for WAN management.

methods.name: WanManager_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets a ULONG parameter value for WAN management.

methods.name: WanManager_Validate
methods.description: Validates WAN parameters before applying changes.

methods.name: WanManager_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value for WAN management.

methods.name: WanManager_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value for WAN management.

methods.name: WanManager_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for WAN management.

methods.name: WanManager_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value for WAN management.

methods.name: WanMgr_DnsConnectivityCheck_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves DNS connectivity check boolean parameter.

methods.name: WanMgr_DnsConnectivityCheck_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets DNS connectivity check boolean parameter.
